'''2011 Belgium Regionals Marc Thery LS Hidden Base (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Marc Thery]] at [[2011 Belgium Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base (V) / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers (V)|VB4-L-hiddenbase-pre.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
